newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ruggiero sees telecoms accord by Feb 15 deadline.
newsitem.headline: Ruggiero sees telecoms accord by Feb 15 deadline.

text.p: World Trade Organisation head Renato Ruggiero said on Tuesday there was every chance of a global accord on freeing up telecommunications markets by the middle of this month.
He was speaking to reporters after a hearing at the French Senate on trade liberalisation.
"All the signs are that we should achieve this by February 15," he said. "All the indications we have encouraging."
February 15 is the deadline for ending talks on opening up telecommunications markets, which are estimated to be worth $600 billion a year.

Speaking at a meeting in Switzerland earlier this week, Ruggiero and European Trade Commissioner Leon Brittan both said there were good chances for an accord but warned that obstacles remained before agreement could be reached.
